dict.Ce facem cu fiecare: What we do with each one
dict.Cifrele vin din Sheets → Evaluarea furni: The figures come from Sheets → Supplier evaluation; deliveries and delays, from the goods receipt notes.
dict.Clasa A: îi păstrăm și îi invităm primii: Class A: we keep them and invite them first to our requests for quotation
dict.Clasa B: le-am cerut un plan de măsuri p: Class B: we asked them for an action plan by [date] (Docs → Supplier evaluation result letter)
dict.Clasa C: cerem oferte noi (Docs → Cerere: Class C: we ask for new offers (Docs → Request for quotation) and compare them (Sheets → Offer comparison)
dict.Contractele de prelungit sau de oprit: S: Contracts to extend or to stop: Sheets → Contract register
dict.Pentru administrator, la sfârșit de an s: For the administrator, at the end of the year or quarter: how the suppliers delivered (on time, without problems), each one’s score and class in a table and a chart, the ones to keep, the ones that must improve, the ones to replace and the decisions requested.
dict.Problemele le-am trimis furnizorilor pri: We sent the problems to the suppliers with Docs → Delivery nonconformity notice.
